package.description: 专注观看体验的跨平台 Bilibili 第三方客户端。

en-US.description: A cross-platform Bilibili third-party client focused on the viewing experience.
en-US.longDescription:
BiliSail is a cross-platform third-party Bilibili client focused on the viewing experience, built with Flutter and Dart for Windows, Android, macOS, iOS and Linux.
BiliSail centres on video, film and live-stream viewing, offering dual and multi-tab browsing, native playback, danmaku, cloud watch history with local resume, and a download queue with offline playback.

zh-CN.description: 专注观看体验的跨平台 Bilibili 第三方客户端。
zh-CN.longDescription:
BiliSail（哔帆）是一款专注观看体验的跨平台 Bilibili 第三方客户端，基于 Flutter 与 Dart 构建，面向 Windows、Android、macOS、iOS 和 Linux。
BiliSail（哔帆）以视频、影视和直播观看为核心，提供双／多标签浏览、原生播放、弹幕、云端观看历史与本地续播，以及下载队列和离线播放。
zh-CN.name: BiliSail
